Pulse for 6 October 2026

The stories from 6 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

Cheaper AI images in Gemini

Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's new AI model for creating and editing images from text, and it is already rolling out in the Gemini app at about half the old API price.

Everyday tool

Claude edits your Google Docs

Claude for Google Workspace is an add-on that puts Anthropic's chatbot in a sidebar next to your open document, spreadsheet or slide deck, so it can edit the file directly.

Everyday tool

AI that runs your computer

Hark Pro is an AI assistant that operates your computer for you, and the startup Hark released it widely on October 6 with a free tier.

Everyday tool

Startups get Claude free

Claude for Startups is a program from Anthropic that now gives young companies a free year of its group plan plus credits for building with Claude.

Everyday tool

Gemini free plan downgrades

Gemini is the AI chatbot from Google, and from October 9 its free plan will only include the small Flash Lite model, The Verge reports.

New model

Mistral Large 4 is a trillion-parameter open-weight bet

Mistral Large 4 is a new AI model from the Paris lab Mistral with one trillion parameters, and the company promises to let anyone download it later this month.

New model

Falcon-Emirati teaches a small model a real dialect

Falcon-Emirati-7B is a small language model built to understand and answer in Emirati Arabic, the dialect people in the UAE actually speak.
